name: zvideo_dd3d_flush_overwrite_polys
description: zVideo_dd3d::FlushOverwritePolys drains the overwrite queue through the Direct3D device provider and restores the depth-test state.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo sorted/overwrite/quad flush pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4ad250 validates the zvid_ddd3d.c source mapping, cdecl no-argument/no-return contract, ZFUNC setup to D3DCMP_ALWAYS, queue iteration over 0x810-byte overwrite entries, and final ZFUNC restore to D3DCMP_GREATEREQUAL with queue-count clearing.

The current BN function has no warning/address tags. The only authored direct callee is zVideo_dd::ReportError at tier C or better; the SetRenderState and DrawPrimitive calls are Direct3D SDK provider vtable dependencies.

Native smokes cover the empty queue provider calls, textured transparent type 0 state setup/restoration, type 4 textured flat path, type 6 modulate path, type 2 untextured flat path, DrawPrimitive provider arguments, cache updates, and overwrite queue clearing.
